plugins.name: pm
plugins.description: Project-management scaffold + session skills. /pm:pm-scaffold stands up a minimal starter (day-one files only; other folders are created on first write per the stamped CLAUDE.md taxonomy); discovery riffs work into a committed intent + size call before planning; whats-next, checkpoint, and stepping-away run the day as per-person session logs; WORKFLOW.md maps the stage chain; verify-before-done gates completion claims on evidence; credential-guard hook blocks committing credential-shaped files; okf and granola-transcript ride along as utility skills.

plugins.name: design-dc
plugins.description: DataCraft design workflow: design-handoff (the crossing brief for claude.ai/design), html-artifacts (rich editorial HTML instead of long markdown), excalidraw-artifacts (HTML artifact → locked Excalidraw markup canvas, and annotation readback), design-sync (component-library sync via the built-in DesignSync tool). Pairs with the separate claude-design bridge plugin.

plugins.name: fm-dc
plugins.description: Agentic FileMaker development: SaXML patching with verify/rollback, DDR analysis, snippet validation, ProofKit and server-connection doctrine, and project scaffolding. Commands /fm-dc:fm-init, fm-scaffold, fm-status, fm-rollback, fm-docs-sync.
